title: Martha Glaser, Granz's secretary
summary: Glaser started as Granz's secretary, scaled theaters sharply, and later managed Erroll Garner.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Uh-huh. Later on. And he really got -- he really got that thing going big in Europe though when he finally started it, you know. He got a big deal going in Europe. But he had a girl helping him who was a tremendous help, I thought. That was Martha Glaser.

And they kind of fell out because she took Erroll Garner off to tour and started managing him sort of. So, that was kind of the beginning of the end of that thing. But she was the one working with him. She was Norman's secretary back there then.

When he first started those tours. And she was so sharp. She could look in a theater and tell you -- just look at it and tell him how he could scale it, and how much she could get from scaling the money, scaling it down. That's how sharp she was. She was -- I knew she was a sharp girl long ago. Yeah, Martha started out with Norman.
She was secretary. She was a big help to Norman back -- She's done a lot for Erroll
